messages.english: Keep newer crop plans safe when an older app session saves its copy.
messages.translation: Hlayisa tipulani letintshwa ta swimilana ti hlayisekile loko xiphemu xa khale xa apu xi hlayisa khopi ya xona.

messages.english: Review retained copies before continuing with your current crop plan.
messages.translation: Kambisisa tikhopi leti hlayisiweke u nga si ya emahlweni hi pulani ya wena ya sweswi ya swimilana.

messages.english: Retry interrupted guest crop transfers without replacing saved account work.
messages.translation: Ringeta nakambe ku hundzisela ntirho wa swimilana wa muendzi lowu kavanyetiweke handle ko siva ntirho wa akhawunti lowu hlayisiweke.
Kambisisa vuhlayiselo bya pulani ya swimilana
Pulani ya vuhumelerisi → Vuhlayiselo bya pulani ya swimilana

messages.english: Check the storage notice. If an older session changed its copy, download both copies and review them before choosing to keep your current plan.
messages.translation: Kambela xitiviso xa vuhlayiselo. Loko xiphemu xa khale xi cincile khopi ya xona, dawuniloda tikhopi hatimbirhi u ti kambisisa u nga si hlawula ku hlayisa pulani ya wena ya sweswi.
